messages:
Alex Chang: Quick idea — can we pilot a 'stickerboard' lane for Wednesday triage to make small bugs + unblockers visual? Thinking 30m box, strict timeboxing, and a weekly 'owner credit' that lets folks skip an assignment if overloaded. Thoughts? @Mike Harris @Jamie Lin

Mike Harris: Love the stickerboard mental model. Can we map sticker colors to JIRA labels so automation picks them up? 30m sounds good. :thumbsup:

Jamie Lin: If it's 30m we need a pre-read. Suggest we post top 3 tickets (with one-line reason) into the thread before the call. Also timebox owners to 2m each.

Tara Nguyen: Agree on pre-read. For owner credits — propose 1 credit per person per sprint, use a `owner-credit` tag in the ticket when applied. Credits should auto-expire at sprint end.

Sushma Patel: Logistics: I can update the recurring invite to 30m and add a slot for 'stickerboard review'. I'll also include the pre-read template in the invite description. Will that work?

Alex Chang: Draft agenda below — want to run as a 3-week experiment. People ok with that?

Alex Chang: ```
Agenda (30m):
1) Quick ack / wins (3m)
2) Stickerboard review (10m) — highlight 5 stickers max (tiny, medium, urgent)
3) Owner picks & commit (7m) — owners confirm in-thread and apply credit if needed
4) Blockers / follow-ups (8m) — list offline deep-dives
```

triage-bot: Reminder updated: weekly triage changed to 30m starting next Wed 11:00 UTC. Poll: https://poll.example/triage-stickerboard (vote for stickers/colors)

Mike Harris: SGTM. I'll map colors to labels and add a small script to generate a simple 'stickerboard' snapshot before each meeting: `python tools/stickerboard.py --labels bug,help-needed,sev-1`

Jamie Lin: Also add a calendar note: "No deep-dive during triage — followups offline" — reduces scope creep.

Alex Chang: Sushma — can you drop the pre-read template here?

Sushma Patel: Sure — paste below: 
- Ticket link (1 line)
- Priority/impact (1 line)
- Owner (name)
- Why now / expected action (1 line)

Mike Harris: :+1:

Alex Chang: OK I'm going to run the 3-week trial and report back with metrics (avg meeting length, number of owner reassigns, and stickerboard hit rate). Thanks team :rocket:
